shown_card_text.title: The agent arrives
shown_card_text.what: The pixel agent hops in, turns into a small 3D figure and the empty window lights up warm behind him. It is one of the six reusable shots you asked for tonight, made from our own graphics.
shown_card_text.why: You asked for six shots we can reuse across every episode.
shown_card_text.question: What should happen to this shot?
shown_card_text.recommendation: Use it as an episode intro bumper.
context: The clip is lower resolution than the episodes, so it gets upscaled in the edit.
It comes with generated sound, which stays labelled until you pick the music.

visual_input_policy: The exact first existing still/poster shown on the source card. It is one frame, not full video or audio.
